name: Craftsman's Writ: Turtle Scale Breastplate
summary: A transferable writ requests a Turtle Scale Breastplate and gives delivery and payment details. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The faded note names a Turtle Scale Breastplate among the items the customer requests. It also gives details for delivery and payment. You need the writ with you when you bring the requested item to the marked location.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Turtle Scale Breastplate.
The writ directs you to the location marked on your map.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Does the writ give payment details?
faq.answer: Yes. The note includes information about payment.
